content: fsnotify v1.10.1 (2026-05-04, module proxy verified) is the standard Go filesystem watcher, used by Viper et al. Caveat for config hot-reload: editors save via atomic rename (write temp + rename) which replaces the inode - must watch the parent directory and match the file name, then re-add; apply debounce (~100-300ms) to coalesce bursts. inotify-based, Linux-native.
